headline: 🚨 Second NetScaler zero-day CVE-2026-88779 lands on KEV, 🔴 FortiMail 9.8 file-write zero-day KEV'd amid mass scanning, 🎭 Alleged ShinyHunters leader caught in Jordan and cooperating, 🇰🇷 Seoul probe flags AI-powered bank attacks, 🧩 GlassWorm hides loaders in VS Code color themes, 🤖 Google suspends OSS bug bounty under AI spam surge
summary: The NetScaler zero-day crisis gained a second exploited SAML flaw now on KEV while FortiMail's CVSS 9.8 file-write bug followed it into the catalog, and the rest of the day belonged to arrests, probes and supply-chain pressure: an alleged ShinyHunters leader in custody, Seoul blaming AI-enabled attack tooling, and Google's bug bounty drowning in AI-generated noise.
